text:
{
  "strengths": [
    "Demonstrates strong visual-spatial processing abilities, evidenced by excellence in art",
    "Shows strong numerical reasoning and problem-solving skills in mathematics",
    "Maintains high engagement and active motivation when provided with Indian Sign Language (ISL) interpretation"
  ],
  "challenges": [
    "Profound hearing impairment creates barriers to accessing spoken instructional content without accommodation",
    "Complete reliance on Indian Sign Language interpreters creates academic vulnerability during interpreter absence",
    "Risk of vocabulary and reading comprehension gaps due to auditory deprivation affecting spoken language acquisition"
  ],
  "learning_style": "Visual learner who processes information most effectively through Indian Sign Language (ISL), visual aids, diagrams, and written text.",
  "recommended_supports": [
    "Dedicated qualified Indian Sign Language (ISL) interpreter for all academic instruction and school activities",
    "Visual-first instructional materials including captioned videos, graphic organizers, and written step-by-step instructions",
    "Note-taking support and provision of lecture notes in advance to allow visual focus on the interpreter"
  ],
  "short_term_goals": [
    "By end of Term 1, student will independently utilize visual graphic organizers to plan and structure written assignments as measured by teacher-graded writing rubrics.",
    "By end of Term 2, student will expand subject-specific vocabulary in mathematics and science by 50 new terms using ISL-to-print flashcards as measured by bi-weekly vocabulary quizzes."
  ],
  "long_term_goals": [
    "By end of academic year, student will maintain an overall academic average of 75% or higher across all subjects, demonstrating independent mastery of Grade 7 curriculum benchmarks as measured by summative term assessments and portfolio reviews."
  ],
  "academic_performance": {
    "overall_level": "at_grade",
    "strong_subjects": [
      "Mathematics",
      "Art"
    ],
    "weak_subjects": [
      "Languages/English"
    ],
    "grade_trajectory": "stable"
  },
  "behavioural_notes": [
    "Active, enthusiastic learner who is highly engaged when communication access is fully provided",
    "Responds very positively to visual reinforcement and inclusive classroom interactions via ISL"
  ],
  "assistive_tech_needs": [
    "Digital tablet with ISL translation and dictionary applications",
    "Speech-to-text live transcription software for supplemental written support",
    "Noise-cancelling headphones for focused independent digital learning tasks"
  ]
}
